scope: Read-only extraction of existing historical development evaluations from the original training host. No training, model evaluation, changed experiment, minibatch-loss substitution, interpolated observation or holdout learning curve was performed. Original source directories remain untouched.

metric.dev_nll: Token-weighted negative log likelihood in natural-log nats per prediction target over the run’s fixed development cohort. Saved summary field nll.
metric.ppl: Derived as math.exp(saved dev_nll); not a held-out score or a training-minibatch loss.
metric.targets: Number of development prediction targets evaluated at each point, not cumulative training exposure.
metric.training_targets: Completed optimizer step × batch × context = step × 2048.
metric.eval_windows: Observed saved summary blocks; each window has256 targets.
metric.eval_documents: Observed distinct document count in each saved evaluation summary, independently checked from NPZ doc_ids.
metric.step: Completed optimizer updates. initial_dev is verified against an original evaluation event with step0; dev_step_N is periodic after N updates; dev_final is after the complete fixed budget.
metric.curve_uncertainty: No inferential band is provided by this extraction. If plotted, compute arithmetic mean dev NLL and sample SD across confirmation seeds at each matched step separately for each arm. The one-seed LR selection curves have no cross-seed SD.

evaluation_implementation.mode: model.eval with no gradient; frozen per-run development offsets/doc_ids; token cross_entropy(reduction=none), sum256 token losses per window, sum window loss_sums then divide total counts.
evaluation_implementation.initial_and_periodic: Trainer evaluate_label saves JSON and NPZ; periodic evaluations occur at eval_every strictly before final step; final is a separately labeled fixed endpoint. Cached completed labels are reused on resume, avoiding duplicate curve points.
evaluation_implementation.training_minibatch_distinction: events update.train_nll is a separate minibatch scalar and is not consumed anywhere in this extraction.
evaluation_implementation.heldout_distinction: Confirmation curves use diagnostic development sets. Final held-out NLL/PPL in paper tables are evaluated on different sets and must not be appended to these curves.

validation.raw_array_method: Original NPZ bytes were read remotely with standard-library zipfile, NumPy .npy headers parsed using ast.literal_eval, float64/int64 payloads unpacked using struct; math.fsum(loss_sums)/sum(counts) recomputed all points. No model/runtime source was imported or executed. All .npy doc_ids/offsets member hashes match the corresponding pre-frozen plan files.

limitations: Development curves are diagnostic or selection evidence, not fresh held-out trajectories.
Small confirmation development data were reused in the earlier research sequence; its final fresh-heldout comparison remains a different metric.
Medium selection and confirmation share the medium development cohort but have different purposes and seed cohorts; do not pool their seeds or LRs.
Mean/sample-SD curves do not establish convergence or statistical significance; all training endpoints were fixed in advance.
Only the saved17points per run are observed. Connecting lines are graphical guides, not additional measured evaluations.

Intermediate rawNPZs and summaryJSONs are not copied into this lightweight package. Their original hashes, frozen-plan binding, numeric values and read-only reanalysis checks are preserved here. Original archive access is needed to independently rehash those omitted files.
No source text, token IDs, full training events, checkpoint tensors, home paths, network addresses or hardware identifiers are included in these outputs.
